verdict.rationale: The evidence shows agent-facing documentation channels: an llms.txt index, markdown doc pages, and MCP tools (summer_docs_search/summer_docs_read) that pull guidance into the chat. These are adjacent retrieval aids, not evidence that the APIs are stable or have abundant public examples that models were trained on. Nothing in the pack shows API stability, versioning guarantees, a large public example corpus, or first-try success of LLM-generated code, so the story's core is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, LLM-generated code mostly works on the first try — stable, well-documented APIs with abundant public examples the models have seen
